theory.body: Shared Blackboard Communication describes the methods and patterns used within Agentic AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Shared Blackboard Communication matters
theory.body: Without Shared Blackboard Communication, systems built with Agentic AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Shared Blackboard Communication works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Shared Blackboard Communication follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Shared Blackboard Communication
theory.body: Shared Blackboard Communication offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
